Package index

Import & validate

Read tidy input and check it before plotting.

mp_read_data()
Read tidy microbiome input files
mp_validate()
Validate tidy microbiome input (feature table + taxonomy + metadata)
mp_validate_mag()
Validate a MAG (metagenome-assembled genome) quality table
mp_validate_contig_lengths()
Validate a per-contig length table
mp_validate_assembly_summary()
Validate an assembly summary table
mp_errors()
Errors from a validation report
mp_warnings()
Warnings from a validation report
mp_is_valid()
Whether a validation report has no errors

Taxonomy fallback & filtering

Shared machinery used by every taxa/function plot.

mp_tax_fix()
Fix unknown/missing taxonomy labels by falling back to the last known rank
mp_filter_taxa()
Filter taxa by minimum abundance and/or prevalence
mp_nested_order_palette()
Build ordering, nested color palette, and nested legend labels for a taxon-colored plot
mp_theme_pub()
Minimal publication-figure ggplot2 theme

Taxonomy plots

mp_taxa_barplot()
Stacked relative-abundance taxa barplot, optionally with a nested legend
mp_taxa_heatmap()
Clustered taxa heatmap
mp_taxa_bubbleplot()
Taxa bubble (dot) plot
mp_asv_gradient_plot()
ASV/taxon abundance over a continuous gradient
mp_alpha_diversity_plot()
Alpha diversity boxplot
mp_beta_diversity_plot()
Beta diversity ordination plot
mp_taxa_treemap()
Taxa (or functional) treemap

Functional profiles

mp_function_barplot()
Functional profile barplot
mp_function_heatmap()
Functional profile heatmap
mp_function_treemap()
Functional treemap

Metagenomics

mp_mag_quality_plot()
MAG (metagenome-assembled genome) quality plot
mp_mag_quality_distribution()
MAG completeness / contamination distribution
mp_assembly_nx_plot()
Assembly Nx curve
mp_assembly_summary_barplot()
Assembly summary barplot
